title: A Parseval-Prefix Improvement for Erdős' Minimum-Overlap Problem
description: Preliminary and unrefereed computer-assisted certificate supporting the proposed composite lower bound c_E > 0.3805603. Parseval energy constraints are prior work; the contribution claimed here is their finite profile-space prefix projection, its use in the two binding central bins, and directed-rounding MPFR verification. The remaining 170 bins use SHA-256-pinned reports from Price's upstream Arb computation. This is not a solution of Erdős Problem 36, has not been independently reproduced, and is not Lean-verified.
notes: The stable concept DOI for all versions is 10.5281/zenodo.21969298; historical v0.1.0-preprint has version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21969299.
